items.title: 68356_Howard R. Scott oral history interview
items.q: Dr. Thompson was the doctor that brought me here.

ctx.x: But he couldn't get any jobs outside of porters or janitor or what you call blue collar jobs. And -- but he loved horses, crazy about horses. He got a job with a white doctor, Dr. Thompson. And he drove for him, because in those days, doctors used to visit their patients. Of course, nowadays, you have to go to the doctor yourself. Doctors are scared to come out, they get mugged for dope, if they think they got dope.

But he drove the buggy for Dr. Thompson. Dr. Thompson was the doctor that brought me here. Yeah, old Dr. Thompson. And from then, he got those kind of jobs, because he didn't have a chance to get a real education, but he wanted his
children to get a good education. I was booked to be either a doctor or a lawyer, and I wound up being a musician.
